snippet: 1/ $RPD , Rapid7, announced a Restructuring on August 10: a 12% workforce cut, $10-11 million in charges, and a target of 20% non-GAAP operating margin by Q4 2026, up from 13.7% in Q2. The person w…
content_text: [1/11 @Tracktacle_app] 1/ $RPD , Rapid7, announced a Restructuring on August 10: a 12% workforce cut, $10-11 million in charges, and a target of 20% non-GAAP operating margin by Q4 2026, up from 13.7% in Q2. The person who ordered it has only been CEO for about two months. https://app.tracktacle.com/publication/NEWS/5290768946914051 --- [2/11 @Tracktacle_app] 2/Wael Mohamed became CEO on June 1, 2026, with longtime CEO Corey Thomas moving to Executive Chairman. Mohamed had been on Rapid7's board since March 2025. --- [3/11 @Tracktacle_app] 3/He got that board seat through JANA Partners. JANA disclosed a 13% stake in Rapid7 in October 2024, working with Cannae Holdings, and pushed for a sale of the company, citing operational execution, forecasting, and governance issues. In March 2025, Rapid7 gave JANA three board seats, including Mohamed, in exchange for JANA keeping its stake below 15% until January 2026. https://www.bankinfosecurity.com/rapid7-gets-truce-activist-investor-adds-3-board-seats-a-27816 --- [4/11 @Tracktacle_app] 4/JANA's stake cap was renegotiated up to almost 20% in March 2026. Mohamed became CEO three months after that. https://app.tracktacle.com/publication/doc/0001193125-26-131752?source=SEC&format=pdf --- [5/11 @Tracktacle_app] 5/So the restructuring is, in effect, the first major move by a CEO an activist investor put in place, after that same activist originally pushed for the company to be sold outright. --- [6/11 @Tracktacle_app] 6/The underlying numbers explain some of the pressure. Q2 2026 revenue was down 1.5% year over year, and Q3 guidance implies roughly a 4% year-over-year decline. Total ARR fell sequentially to $824 million, guided down further to about $812 million for Q3. --- [7/11 @Tracktacle_app] 7/The decline is concentrated in a small part of the business. Non-core products, under 20% of ARR, drove the drop. Core Platform ARR grew about 1% year over year. Detection and Response, about 55% of ARR, grew about 5%. Management said Exposure Management "is not yet where it needs to be." --- [8/11 @Tracktacle_app] 8/This isn't a cash problem. Rapid7 had $702.6 million in cash, cash equivalents, and government securities as of June 30, 2026. The cuts are about margin, not survival. --- [9/11 @Tracktacle_app] 9/Market cap is about $642.91 million. Rapid7 also carries roughly $894 million in convertible notes ($600 million at 0.25% due 2027, $300 million at 1.25% due 2029). Add that debt and subtract the $702.6 million of cash and investments, and enterprise value comes out to roughly $834 million. --- [10/11 @Tracktacle_app] 10/An activist took a stake, got board seats, raised its ownership cap, installed its own director as CEO, and two months later that CEO cut 12% of the workforce to chase a specific margin target. Whether that's enough on its own, or a step toward the sale JANA originally wanted, isn't decided yet. --- [11/11 @Tracktacle_app] 11/Caught by our special situation monitor, still in beta and not public yet.
